languagePack.name: Chinese (Simplified) Language Pack / 中文语言包

operations: Invoked the product's native Install Chinese Language Pack action through Search Everywhere.
Confirmed platform version 261.26222.65 and fetched the matched official pack.
Selected localization-zh.zip in the native plugin file chooser and completed the native install flow.
Installed Plugins showed Chinese (Simplified) Language Pack / 中文语言包 261.26222.65 from JetBrains as installed and enabled.
Changed Language and Region to zh_CN, applied, and used the native Restart IDE action.
After restart, menus, project tree, Search Everywhere, settings, notifications, and status-bar descriptions rendered in Simplified Chinese.

marketplaceObservation.ordinaryPluginCandidates: Compatible free and third-party Paid plugins appeared with native Install actions.
marketplaceObservation.simplifiedPackDiscovery: The official Simplified pack was handled by the dedicated official-distribution action rather than the general Marketplace result card.
marketplaceObservation.boundary: This observation does not prove every JetBrains plugin or every Marketplace candidate is compatible.

customUiBoundary: The Terminal tool-window name remains English.
Several custom Go tool-window labels and the project run-configuration name remain English.
The Go Workbench and LSP4IJ plugin names remain English.
processesAfterVerification: The exact candidate app was closed after the restart and localization observation; no remaining process or test child from this check was retained.
evidenceBoundary: This is native macOS GUI evidence for the current source candidate. Windows interactive language-pack installation, exhaustive third-party plugins, and complete Go UI localization remain separate checks.
